explanation: N3293- fires on a subword token that does not end the word it belongs to: the text immediately after the token continues the same word or abbreviation, so the current word is being spelled out across several pieces (' ins'+'omniacs', ' une'+'easily', ' veget'+'arians', ' rec'+'aps', 'op'+'етровск', ' re'+'-suspended'). The same string at a word boundary, or a word that fits in a single token, is inactive; among non-final pieces the firing rate is several times higher in rare, long, technical or non-Latin-script words (about 2-4% of such positions fire above 1, versus about 0.2% of word-final pieces).
